long_biography.plain_text:
FC Krasnodar expresses Sergey Galitsky's preference for building institutions around his home city. He founded the club in 2008 and established a youth programme intended to bring academy graduates into the first team. A purpose-built stadium and neighbouring public park gave the project a lasting civic presence.

The academy grew through regional branches and a residential training centre, linking youth development to a professional side that advanced from the lower divisions. Galitsky remains club president, and Krasnodar won its first Russian Premier League title in 2025. The achievement completed a progression built around the club's own infrastructure and player-development system.
